title.narrative: Danish Contribution to support the Programme of Work and Budget of OECD-DAC: Mobilising Finance for Sustainable Development

description.narrative: The overall objective is to strengthen the evidence base, policy coordination and donor alignment needed to scale the use of guarantees and other blended-finance instruments in development cooperation. The project will support the OECD DAC Secretariat in advancing two complementary workstreams: (1) the production of a data-driven analytical report on the risk profile of development guarantees, aimed particularly at informing ministries of finance and other key technical decision-makers in donor countries; and (2) the implementation of the Scaling Mobilization Implementation Plan (SMIP) under the DAC’s Community of Practice for Private Sector Mobilization, which seeks to operationalise the 2025 DAC High-Level Meeting communiqué on innovative financing. Together, these initiatives will enhance donor collaboration on guarantees, standard-setting and transparency agendas, and strengthen the international enabling environment for mobilising private capital. The project will also reinforce Denmark’s strategic positioning in the OECD as a leading actor on innovative financing.
